normal-distribution.label: Mean error μ
normal-distribution.description: Mean of the declared normal error model in mm

normal-distribution.label: Standard deviation σ
normal-distribution.description: Positive standard deviation of the declared model in mm

normal-distribution.label: Cumulative probability
normal-distribution.description: Subtract the mean error from the threshold, divide by the positive standard deviation, and evaluate the standard normal CDF. The density curve supplies a height per millimetre; its accumulated area supplies probability.

exponential-distribution.label: Cumulative probability
exponential-distribution.description: Multiply arrival rate by elapsed waiting time, exponentiate its negative to obtain survival, and subtract survival from one for cumulative arrival probability. Waiting duration differs from the number of events in a fixed interval.

sign-test.label: Added after-reading shift h
sign-test.description: Common added after-reading shift in mm

sign-test.label: One-sided sign-tail probability
sign-test.description: Compute each shifted after-reading minus its paired before-reading. Omit exact zeros, count k positives among n nonzero pairs, and sum the fair binomial masses from k through n for the predeclared positive-direction alternative.
